messages:
Nia (product): Heads-up: multiple enterprise customers asking for exportable cost breakdowns + a deterministic way to surface a canonical trace from error cards. Need to scope for next quarter.
Omar (eng): Two workstreams: cost attribution UI + export; and trace pointer/index for error->trace reconstruction. Both touch infra and retention.
Priya (sre): Ops constraints: we can keep lightweight pointers for every error (span id + ingest offsets) to avoid storing full traces. Reconstruction on-demand is possible but will spike IO. Need quotas and backpressure.
Sam (acct): Customers want CSV exports that map to invoices. Most will accept opt-in paid feature; legal will require audit trail for any full-trace exports.
Vera (design): UX idea: add "Cost" tab to workspace with top routes, avg cost/req, export button. Error card should show a "Trace pointer" badge; if full trace not sampled show a CTA "Request full trace" and a clear fetching state.
Nia (product): Proposed prioritization: 1) Cost-breakdown MVP (top 20 routes + CSV) 2) Trace-pointer index for errors 3) On-demand reconstruction/export for enterprise opt-in. Launch gates: exportable CSV, trace-pointer visible in error UI, audit logs for exports.
Omar (eng): Effort estimate: cost tab + CSV ~1.5 sprints (pipeline + UI). Pointer index ~1 sprint. Reconstruction/export spike ~2 sprints to validate cold-read perf and costs. Plan canary with one Dedicated customer to measure econ.
Priya (sre): Ops checklist: export job queue, throttling, per-customer quotas, revoke/export audit, alerts for export cost > 2x baseline, retention alignment. SLO proposal: 90% exports complete < 60s in canary.
Sam (acct): I'll confirm contract language for opt-in paid export and coordinate legal/security sign-off.
Nia (product): Risks: storage/IO cost, PII leakage in full traces (require redaction), and user confusion when reconstruct fails. Mitigations: gating, audit logs, redaction pipeline, clear UX errors.
Omar (eng): Action items: I will open RFC with data model for cost rows and the trace-pointer schema (id, ingest refs, offsets), API for export, and cost model. Will propose a canary plan.
Vera (design): I'll prototype the cost tab and error-card pointer treatment; will mock incremental trace streaming UI.
Priya (sre): I'll draft ops runbook and quotas.
pm-bot: Reminder: RFC review scheduled for 1711520000.
Nia (product): Thanks — please drop links to RFC & mocks here when ready. Target decision for planning sync next week.
